title: Tech Challenges quiz
description: A set of questions about Java. Lives in <folder>/<quiz-id>/quiz.json. Guide: docs/quizzes.md

id.description: Unique id. Defaults to the folder name (recommended: leave it out).

title.description: Name shown in the Quizzes group and at the top of the quiz.

enumDescriptions: Multiple choice. "answer" is the index of the right option (0 = first), or a list of indexes when several are right.
True or false. "answer" is true or false.
Short answer typed by the student. "answer" is an accepted answer or a list of them.
What does this code print? "answer" is the exact output (leave it "" and run Validate → fill in expected outputs), or an option index when "options" is given.

prompt.description: The question (Markdown). Optional for "output" (defaults to "What does this code print?").

code.description: Java code shown with the question. For "output" it is compiled and run by the validator; a snippet is wrapped in void main() { … }.

options.description: Choices for "choice", or for "output" when the student picks instead of typing.

answer.description: The right answer; its form depends on "type".

explanation.description: Shown after a practice check (Markdown). Never shown during an exam.

points.description: Points for this question (all or nothing).
